grades.reason: Covers float/integer type-convert instructions, not signed vs. unsigned integer comparison.
Pseudocode operator and keyword conventions. It lists signed()/unsigned() casts but describes no comparison instructions.
Describes LoongArch SLTI (signed) and SLTUI (unsigned) integer comparison instructions side by side. It gives their semantics and pseudocode, and notes that SLTUI still sign-extends the immediate.

Lists the RISC-V vector integer compare instructions, with signed variants (vmslt, vmsle, vmsgt) and unsigned variants (vmsltu, vmsleu, vmsgtu). It states that each writes 1 to the destination mask element if the comparison is true and 0 otherwise.
